verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a versioned REST API, a published OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec, a Postman collection and an MCP server, but no official SDK or client library. An OpenAPI spec is a developer building block, and community-written API wrapper scripts are a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit for this story. The Forge mention covers provisioning demo development sites only and does not describe an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
